concepts.name: Flow matching
concepts.summary: A generative method that learns a VELOCITY FIELD rather than a noise predictor, so that generation is an ODE solve: x ← x + v_θ(x,t)·Δt, integrated from t=0 (noise) to t=1 (data). The path is chosen to be a straight line, x_t = (1−t)·x₀ + t·x₁, which makes the velocity target trivially x₁ − x₀ — constant, with no β schedule, no ᾱ table and no square roots. Because a straight path has constant velocity, large integration steps stay accurate, so sampling needs roughly 5–20 steps rather than diffusion's hundreds. Note the convention flip against the diffusion wing: here t=0 is noise and t=1 is data.
